skills.name: branch-cleaner
skills.description: Audit and safely remove stale, merged, or gone Git branches locally and on remotes. Use when the user asks to list, prune, or delete old branches or review branch hygiene.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: bug-triage
skills.description: Reproduce and isolate a reported bug or failing check, explain the root cause, and implement a minimal verified fix when authorized. Use for regressions, runtime failures, and broken builds or tests.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: ci-fix
skills.description: Diagnose and fix failing GitHub Actions checks using GitHub connector context plus gh logs and local verification. Use when a pull request, branch, or workflow run is failing in GitHub Actions.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: commit-work
skills.description: Create reviewable Git commits by inspecting the worktree, staging only intended changes, choosing logical boundaries, and writing repository-appropriate messages. Use when asked to stage, commit, split commits, or craft commit messages.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: create-pr
skills.description: Prepare and open a focused GitHub pull request from a local checkout, including branch strategy, validation, commits, push, and a truthful PR description. Use when asked to prepare, publish, or open a PR.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: dependency-upgrader
skills.description: Upgrade Java, Kotlin, Gradle, Maven, Node, or TypeScript dependencies with small verified changes and supply-chain safeguards. Use for routine version bumps, framework migrations, and vulnerability remediation.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: docs-sync
skills.description: Update only the documentation affected by a code or configuration change and verify examples, links, contracts, and operational steps against their source of truth. Use for README, API, runbook, and release documentation drift.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: rebase-assistant
skills.description: Safely rebase a Git branch onto an explicit or discovered target, resolve conflicts by intent, and verify rewritten history. Use when asked to rebase, update a branch, or handle rebase conflicts.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: regex-builder
skills.description: Build, debug, explain, and verify regular expressions for a specified engine using representative matches and non-matches. Use for search, validation, extraction, capture groups, and replacements.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: release-notes
skills.description: Draft accurate release notes or changelog entries from an exact Git range and repository metadata, including breaking changes, migrations, security impact, and upgrade steps. Use for releases, tags, and change summaries.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: vps-checkup
skills.description: Audit an Ubuntu VPS and optional Docker workloads through SSH, producing an evidence-based health, exposure, update, and security report. Use for read-only server checkups; mutate or restart only with explicit approval.
skills.author: jMerta
